statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.hn s (f-g) = KdVPlan.hn s (g-f)
proof:
intro s f g
unfold KdVPlan.hn
congr 1
apply tsum_congr
intro k
simp only [Pi.sub_apply, norm_sub_rev]
